thread:
marina_docs: Heads-up — noticed Console embeds are being blocked by CSP on some customers' pages. Screenshot and customer report attached to ticket #783. Need a quick docs fix + snippet fallback so customers don't hit a 3-day support loop.

alex_d: Which browsers/environments are failing? any repro steps?

marina_docs: Repro: Chrome 117 with strict third-party cookie settings, and Safari iOS 17.1. The embed is an <iframe src=\"https://embed.redwood.ai/...\"> and a customer's page sends a restrictive frame-ancestors CSP so the iframe never loads. Also found the docs link that explains CSP is 404ing (old path).

samira: I can add a short migration note and a couple of tiny snippets (React + plain JS) that show the SDK embed + a postMessage handshake fallback. Will open a PR. Keep examples to 2–3 lines each.

marina_docs: Perfect. Also update the broken link — current page points to /security/csp which 404s; it should go to /security/headers. It's referenced in docs/snippets/embed.md line ~42.

docs-bot: CI check failed on branch docs/embed-csp-fix — broken link /security/csp (404).

samira: Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1204 — adds React + vanilla JS embed examples, nginx header snippet, X-Frame-Options note, and the link fix. Tagging reviewers.

alex_d: I can review later today. Quick Q: should we include a server-side header example for nginx showing Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors? I vote yes, one-liner.

taylan: +1 for nginx. Also add X-Frame-Options fallback example. For SDK embed, include a tiny postMessage handshake to detect when a frame is blocked. Keep it minimal.

samira: Updated PR with Nginx + X-Frame-Options + postMessage handshake. Example in the PR:

```html
<!-- plain JS embed handshake -->
<iframe id=\"rw-embed\" src=\"https://embed.redwood.ai/app/XYZ\"></iframe>
<script>
  const iframe = document.getElementById('rw-embed');
  window.addEventListener('message', e => { if (e.data === 'rw-ready') console.log('embed ready'); });
  // fallback: if no message in 2s, show help text about CSP/frame-ancestors
  setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('.embed-help').style.display = 'block', 2000);
</script>
```

and the nginx snippet: 

```nginx
add_header Content-Security-Policy "frame-ancestors 'self' https://app.example.com";
# fallback
add_header X-Frame-Options "ALLOW-FROM https://app.example.com";
```

samira: PTAL @alex_d @taylan — trying to keep the copy short and prescriptive.

docs-bot: Lint passed; linkcheck pending.

marina_docs: After merge, can we backport a one-line note into the v1 Console docs? Some customers are on the older console. If not, at least add a redirect from /security/csp -> /security/headers.

alex_d: I'll handle the redirect once it's merged.

samira: Merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1204/merge ✅ (reacts :tada:)

docs-bot: Linkcheck: all links OK. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-1204--docs.redwood.ai/console/embed#csp

marina_docs: Verified staging preview; CSP note and snippets visible. Thanks everyone. I'll open a follow-up support-watch ticket to monitor for 48h and capture any customer confusion.

alex_d: Thanks — great quick turnaround.

tally: (thread closed, small follow-ups in ticket #784)
